title: Trump, Zelenskyy signal progress in Ukraine peace talks after Mar-a-Lago meeting
summary: President Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met Sunday at Mar-a-Lago to work towards a peace plan between Russia and Ukraine. After the meeting, Mr. Trump said he thinks they are "closer than ever before" to an agreement, but the Donbas region remains a sticking point. Willie James Inman has the latest.
